description: Détails des circulations quotidiennes des trains SNCF d'Île-de-France (RER et Transiliens) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AlertesRER. Information For now the data are published manually and at undetermined time intervals. Eventually, they will be published on a daily basis, automatically. Description Each line in the file describes a train of the relevant line, where: ‘year’: The year that train ran. ‘month’: The month that train ran. Coverage: AlertesRER. The portal shows the English title as "Details of daily traffic of SNCF trains in Île-de-France (RER and Transiliens)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is AlertesRER. Its keywords include rer, ponctualite, sncf, transilien, circulation. The listing shows 6 download or service links in CSV. The listing shows 2020-02-09 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
